derivation: Twin-mediator set-valued frontdoor: latent U confounds X-Y; X splits into two disjoint mediators M1 and M2 which each carry one directed X->Y path. Neither singleton intercepts every directed path so no singleton frontdoor exists, but Z = {M1, M2} does. At coefficients a = 0.5 on every edge and unit disturbance variances, the closed-form (I - B^T)^-1 propagation matrix gives TE(X->Y) = 2a^2 = 0.5. Sigma_XX = 1 + a^2 = 1.25, Sigma_XY = 3a^2 + 2a^4 = 0.875, so the naive OLS slope beta(empty) = 0.7 (bias +0.2). The set-valued frontdoor first stage is beta_ZX = [a, a] = [0.5, 0.5]; Sigma_{ZZ|X} collapses to I after the Schur cancellation, Sigma_{ZY|X} = [a, a]^T = [0.5, 0.5]^T, giving beta_YZX = [0.5, 0.5] and beta_FD = 0.5*0.5 + 0.5*0.5 = 0.5, which matches TE exactly. Verifies Pearl 2009 Thm. 3.3.4 for a set-valued mediator.
